title: VersioningEvent
description: Outbox event envelope (versioning.md §12), published on subject `versioning.<event>`. Opaque ids and immutable oids only; never raw medical data. Delivery is at-least-once: consumers dedupe by event_id. The de-identification worker subscribes to review.opened and review.checks_requested.

data.description: Event-specific ids: branch, commit_oid, previous_oid, review_id, source_oid, target_oid, merge_oid, tag, manifest_root.
